plates.name: Sharks
plates.idea: Sharks own nothing and build nothing. They roam, they fight, and every fight leaves Blood in the water. Each Blood is a meal, a frenzy that brings more sharks, or something shiny to craft with.

rules.title: Keep swimming
rules.text: At Dusk, every shark that didn't move this turn drowns.

rules.title: Big
rules.text: Each shark counts as two warriors whenever warriors are counted, including for rule and for the hits you can deal.

rules.title: Blood in the water
rules.text: While sharks are in the game, any attack that removes a warrior leaves a Blood token in that reef, one per reef. Blood belongs to no one. Your sharks can move to a Blood reef up to two channels away, ignoring rule.

turn.text: 1 shark arrives at any gate, or 2 if you have none on the map.
3 actions: hunt. A hunt moves sharks from one reef, then they may battle where they arrive.
Each Blood in a reef with your sharks: feed on it, or frenzy (remove it and 2 sharks arrive there, as if they had moved). Then any shark that stayed still drowns.

scores: Feeding on a Blood at Dusk: 2 VP.
plates.choice: Every Blood is 2 VP, 2 more sharks, or gear. Never more than one of them.

quirk.title: Open ocean
quirk.text: Sharks at a gate can swim to any other gate as one move. They dive out of the reef and turn up on the far side.

plates.craft: Blood in a reef with your sharks pays that reef's suit. Crafting eats it, for no VP.

plates.name: Sardines
plates.idea: A race across the map. Schools come in through one gate and score by leaving through another. The bigger the school, the more it scores, but the longer it stays, the more gets eaten. A big enough school shoves everyone out of its way.

rules.title: The run
rules.text: At Dawn, 3 sardines arrive at any gate. The game remembers the gate every fish came in by. Fish that rally count as coming in by the gate most of their school came in by.

rules.title: One school
rules.text: A move takes all your sardines in a reef together, up to two channels, ignoring rule. A school of 6 or more can mob: battle, dealing at most 1 hit for every 3 fish.

rules.title: Bait ball
rules.text: When battled, before any hits, you may give up the fight: lose half the school, rounded down, and move the rest to a neighboring reef. The lost fish count as removed by the attack.

turn.text: The run arrives.
3 actions: move, mob, or rally (discard a card: 2 sardines join a school in a reef of the card's suit).
Schools on a gate may leave the map.

scores: At Dusk, sardines on a gate they didn't come in by may leave: 1–3 fish score 1 VP, 4–6 score 2, 7–9 score 4, 10 or more score 6. They go back to your supply.
plates.choice: Cash a school in now, or grow it for a bigger payout while everything hunts it.

quirk.title: Wall of fish
quirk.text: Right after a school of 6 or more arrives, you may push one faction that has fewer warriors there: all its warriors there move to a neighboring reef of your choice.

plates.craft: Each reef with 4 or more of your sardines pays its suit.

plates.name: Lionfish
plates.idea: An invasive species with no natural enemies on this reef. Lionfish breed every turn and eat whatever they outnumber, then sit there, too stuffed to move.

rules.title: Breed
rules.text: At Dusk, each reef with 3 or more of your lionfish breeds 1 lionfish, placed there or in a neighboring reef. At Dawn, if you have fewer than 2 lionfish on the map, 2 more arrive at any gate.

rules.title: Gorge
rules.text: Attack a faction whose warriors you outnumber in a reef: it takes 1 hit. No dice, and no hits back.

rules.title: Venom
rules.text: A faction that battles your lionfish takes 1 hit before the dice are rolled.

turn.text: If you have fewer than 2 lionfish on the map, 2 arrive at a gate.
3 actions: move, battle, gorge, or release once (discard a card: 2 lionfish arrive at any gate).
Breed, then score.

scores: 1 VP for each warrior your gorging removes.
At Dusk, after breeding, 1 VP per reef where you have 6 or more lionfish and no other faction has warriors.

ways.Battle: Gorge with no dice, or battle

plates.choice: Spread out to breed everywhere, or pile up to hold reefs alone. Gorge now and sit stuffed, or keep moving.

quirk.title: Stuffed
quirk.text: After gorging, your lionfish in that reef can't move or gorge again for the rest of the turn. A lionfish's stomach can stretch to thirty times its size.

plates.craft: Each reef where 3 or more of your lionfish are the only warriors pays its suit.

plates.name: Starfish
plates.idea: A plague that eats reefs down to rubble. Starfish crawl toward anything built, eat it, and leave Rubble behind. Hitting them only makes more.

rules.title: Devour
rules.text: An action in a reef with 3 or more of your starfish: remove an enemy building there, or put Rubble in an empty slot if none of your Rubble is there yet. Rubble is a token that fills its slot for everyone.

rules.title: Drawn to food
rules.text: Your starfish can move into a reef with an enemy building, ignoring rule.

rules.title: Spawn
rules.text: At Dawn, discard up to 2 cards. Each adds 2 starfish to a reef of its suit where you have starfish, or to any reef of its suit if you have none on the map.

plates.setup: 3 starfish in each of two neighboring reefs that aren't gates.

turn.text: Spawn.
2 actions: move, battle or devour.
Score.

scores: 1 VP per building devoured, like any building removed.
At Dusk, 1 VP for every 2 reefs that have your Rubble, rounded up.
plates.choice: Eat a building for a point now, or lay Rubble that pays every Dusk. Two actions: eat here, or crawl to the next meal.

quirk.title: Cut in half
quirk.text: After any attack removes your starfish, 2 starfish regrow in the neighboring reef where you have the most. Divers once chopped them up to kill them.

plates.craft: Your Rubble pays its reef's suit.

plates.name: Coral
plates.idea: A living reef. It can't take a step, but it spreads by spawning, stings whatever comes too close, and fish shelter in it. Grow tall for points, or leave room for visitors who pay you every Dusk.

rules.title: Rooted
rules.text: Polyps never move, not even along currents or when pushed.

rules.title: Spawn
rules.text: Once per turn, discard a card: each reef of its suit with your coral puts 1 polyp into every neighboring reef. With a Moon card, every reef with your coral spawns. If you have no coral on the map, the spawn instead puts 2 polyps into one reef of the card's suit.

rules.title: Living reef
rules.text: When you are battled, each of your coral in that reef counts as a warrior for the hits you can deal.

plates.setup: 2 coral and 3 polyps in one reef that isn't a gate, and 1 polyp in each neighboring reef.

turn.text: Nothing.
3 actions: grow (discard a card of the reef's suit to build a coral in an empty slot of a reef you rule), spawn, or battle.
Score the Nursery. Draw 1 extra card per 5 coral on the map.

scores: Each coral scores when grown: 1 VP for every 4 coral on the map, at least 1.
Nursery: at Dusk, 1 VP per reef with your coral where another faction has warriors.
plates.choice: Grow this turn, or bleach a coral for cards and grow bigger later. Crowd visitors out, or let them in for Nursery points, knowing they might wreck you.

quirk.title: Bleach
quirk.text: In a turn when you don't grow, you may take one of your coral out of the game to draw 2 cards. Stressed coral spits out its algae, turns white and dies.

plates.craft: Each reef with your coral pays its suit, however many coral it has.

plates.name: Jellyfish
plates.tagline: We can't steer. We bend the current.
plates.idea: You never steer a jellyfish. They drift every turn, and all you control is the current that carries them. Whatever swims into them gets stung, and even a dead jellyfish comes back.

rules.title: Drift
rules.text: At Dusk, your jellyfish in each reef follow one current leading out of it, one channel. No current, no drift. Drifting ignores rule.

rules.title: Your currents
rules.text: You own 4 current arrows. Each turns an empty channel into a one-way current, and currents work for every faction.

rules.title: Sting
rules.text: When another faction moves warriors into a reef with 2 or more of your jellyfish, by any kind of movement, it takes 1 hit, which removes one of the arrivals.

plates.setup: 3 jellyfish in each of two reefs on the Gyre.

turn.text: Cysts become jellyfish.

Place or turn up to 2 arrows. Bloom up to twice: discard a card, and 1 jellyfish joins every reef of its suit where you have jellyfish (Moon: every such reef); with none on the map, 3 bloom in one reef of its suit. Pulse once: battle in a reef with 3 or more of your jellyfish.
Drift, then score.

scores: 1 VP each time a sting removes a warrior.
At Dusk, after drifting, 1 VP per reef with 3 or more of your jellyfish, 2 VP if it has 6 or more.

ways.Battle: Pulse once a turn from a swarm

plates.choice: Aim the currents at enemies to sting them, or hold your swarms still to score.

quirk.title: Immortal
quirk.text: When an attack removes the last of your jellyfish in a reef, leave a cyst token there. At your Dawn, each cyst becomes 2 jellyfish.

plates.craft: Each reef with 3 or more of your jellyfish pays its suit.

plates.name: Parrotfish
plates.tagline: Every beach was a reef once.
plates.idea: Parrotfish chew the reef into sand and use the sand to reshape the map. Sandbars cut channels and islands rise out of the sea. At night they sleep in a bubble of their own slime.

rules.title: Graze
rules.text: In a reef you rule, remove one enemy building or token and gain 3 Sand. If there is nothing to eat, chew the bare reef for 2 Sand, once per reef each turn.

rules.title: Sandbar
rules.text: Spend 2 Sand to put a sandbar on a channel next to a reef you rule. For everyone but you, the two reefs stop being neighbors. A faction with warriors at both ends can spend a move to dig it out.

rules.title: Island
rules.text: Spend 4 Sand to raise an island in a reef you rule that touches 2 of your sandbars. You rule it for the rest of the game, your parrotfish there can't be attacked, and the island can't be removed.

turn.text: 2 parrotfish arrive in a reef you rule, or at a gate if you rule none.
3 actions: move, battle, graze, place a sandbar or raise an island.
Score islands. Your old cocoon opens, and you may spin a new one.

scores: 1 VP per sandbar placed, 3 VP per island raised.
At Dusk, 1 VP per island.
plates.choice: Sand builds sandbars and islands, or buys gear. A cocoon keeps a reef safe but pins it for a turn.

quirk.title: Pajamas
quirk.text: At Dusk, you may wrap your parrotfish in one reef you rule in a slime cocoon. Until your next Dusk they can't be attacked or pushed, and they can't move.

plates.craft: Your islands pay their suit, and 3 Sand pays any suit.

plates.name: Sea Turtles
plates.idea: Four old turtles swim far out to feed, riding the currents, then come home to lay eggs on the shore. Every hatchling has to dash past whatever is waiting on the beach.

rules.title: Shell
rules.text: Ignore the first hit of every attack on your turtles.

rules.title: Wander
rules.text: Turtles move one at a time, one channel per move, ignoring rule. A turtle can also ride a current as far as it flows, as one move.

rules.title: Feed and lay
rules.text: A turtle away from the shore can feed: it takes a Food of the reef's suit, at most one of each suit. A turtle at your nest lays 1 egg per Food it carries, plus 2, using the Food up.

plates.setup: 1 nest and all 4 turtles in one shore reef.

turn.text: Every egg hatches and scores 1 VP. While you have fewer than 4 turtles, a hatchling also becomes a new turtle on its nest. With no turtles at all, one returns to any shore reef.
3 actions: move, battle, feed, lay, or build a nest in an empty slot of a shore reef where you have a turtle.
Nothing.

scores: 1 VP per egg laid, and 1 VP more when it hatches.
Nests score when built: 1, 2, 3.

ways.Move: One turtle at a time, or ride a current

plates.choice: Food makes eggs or pays for gear. Lay at the safe nest far away, or the close one with enemies on the beach.

quirk.title: Hatchling dash
quirk.text: An egg that hatches in a reef with enemy warriors is eaten on its way to the sea: it scores you nothing, and the faction that rules that reef scores 1 VP.

plates.craft: Your nests pay their reef's suit. Each Food a turtle carries pays its suit and is used up.

plates.name: Sea Snake
plates.tagline: The more it eats, the longer it gets.
plates.idea: One snake with one long body stretched across the map. It grows by eating and by shedding its skin, and it coils around whatever it catches. A single hit in the middle can cut it in two.

rules.title: One body
rules.text: Your Head and segments form a line, each piece in the same reef as the piece ahead of it or next to it. To slither, move the Head one channel, ignoring rule; each segment moves to where the piece ahead of it was. Your pieces can't be pushed.

rules.title: Grow
rules.text: For each enemy warrior your bites and coils remove, add a segment at your tail. At Dawn, a snake with fewer than 4 pieces adds a segment.

rules.title: Cut
rules.text: A hit on your snake always removes the piece nearest the tail among those it can hit. If that splits the body, the part behind the cut is lost. If the Head goes, the next segment becomes the Head; if nothing is left, a new Head arrives at any gate at your next Dawn.

plates.setup: The Head and 3 segments in one reef that isn't a gate.

turn.text: Nothing.
2 actions, or 3 once you have 9 pieces: slither, bite (battle in the Head's reef), or molt (discard a card: add 2 segments).
Score.

scores: At Dusk, 1 VP for every 2 reefs your snake is in, rounded up.

ways.Battle: Bite at the Head, or coil

plates.choice: Stretch out for points, or coil back on yourself to squeeze. Shed your tail for gear, or keep the length for actions.

quirk.title: Coil
quirk.text: When your Head slithers into a reef where the rest of your body already is, every other faction's warriors there take 1 hit.

plates.craft: Shed your tail: each segment you take off the end of your snake pays any suit. You can't shed the Head.

plates.name: Remoras
plates.tagline: Why swim when you can ride?
plates.idea: Remoras don't hold ground. They stick to other factions, go where they go, clean them for a fee and pile into their fights.

rules.title: Attach
rules.text: Stick free remoras onto another faction's warriors in the same reef. Attached remoras can't be hit. When the last of those warriors leaves the reef, the remoras go with it; if those warriors are all removed, the remoras drop off.

rules.title: Tiny
rules.text: Remoras never count for rule, and free remoras move ignoring rule. They only play in games with at least two other factions.

rules.title: Pile on
rules.text: When a faction you ride starts a battle, your remoras on it in that reef add 1 hit each, up to 2.

turn.text: 1 remora arrives at any gate.
3 actions: swim (move free remoras one channel), attach, let go, clean, or hitch (discard a card: 2 new remoras attach to a faction's warriors in a reef of the card's suit).
Score your rides.

scores: 1 VP each time a faction you ride removes pieces of a faction other than yours, once per attack.
At Dusk, 1 VP per faction that 2 or more of your remoras ride.
plates.choice: Ride the fiercest fighter for scraps, or as many factions as you can for Dusk points. Cleaning feeds you both: is that host worth feeding?

quirk.title: Cleaning station
quirk.text: Once per turn, an action in a reef where your remoras ride a faction: that faction draws a card, and so do you.

plates.craft: Each reef where 3 or more of your remoras ride pays its suit.

plates.name: Hermit Crabs
plates.idea: The reef's only shell shop. Other factions buy shells to protect their warriors, and every card they pay becomes an action for the crabs. And whenever someone's home is wrecked, a crab moves in.

rules.title: Shell shop
rules.text: At the start of another faction's Day, it may buy shells from your pool at your price, paying in cards. Each shell goes in a reef where the buyer has pieces and ignores the next hit on the buyer's pieces there, then comes back to your pool. Shells are rented: all of them come back at your Dawn. Shells can't be hit or taken.

rules.title: Till
rules.text: Cards paid to you go into your Till, and at Dawn you may add cards from your hand. Every Day action costs one Till card.

rules.title: Own shells
rules.text: Your crabs can wear shells from your pool for free, the same way.

plates.setup: 1 market and 4 crabs in any reef.

turn.text: Add cards to your Till.
Actions, one Till card each: move, battle, recruit (3 crabs at a market, or at any gate if you have no market), or build a market in a reef you rule (the Till card must match the reef's suit).
Set your shell price (1 to 3 cards), then score your markets.

scores: At Dusk, 1 VP per market on the map.
plates.choice: Price shells high to bank fewer, richer sales, or low to sell more. Every Till card is an action or a market.

quirk.title: Vacancy chain
quirk.text: When another faction's building is removed from a reef with your crabs, one of your markets moves into the empty slot for free.

plates.craft: Your markets pay their reef's suit.

plates.name: Anglerfish
plates.idea: They live in the Trench and never swim the reef. They hang lures with real rewards over it, and whoever takes the bait is hooked.

rules.title: Lures
rules.text: At Dawn, place or move your lures in rim reefs or their neighbors and pick each lure's offer. Treasure: a faction that moves warriors here draws a card, once per turn. Shelter: warriors here can't be battled except by you. Glory: a faction that rules this reef at the end of its turn scores 1 VP. You start with 2 lures; the 3rd and 4th unlock after your snaps remove 4 and 8 warriors.

rules.title: Snap
rules.text: At Dusk, at up to 2 lure or rim reefs with enemy warriors, you may bring up to 3 anglers out of the Trench and battle one faction there. You deal 1 hit before the dice, the first bite. Survivors sink back into the Trench.

rules.title: The Trench
rules.text: Your anglers live in the Trench, off the map, where nothing can attack them.

plates.setup: 3 anglers in the Trench and 2 lures.

turn.text: Set your lures.
Discard up to 2 cards: each adds 2 anglers to the Trench.
Snap.

scores: 1 VP per enemy warrior your snaps remove.
plates.choice: Treasure hooks a faction so you can snap it anywhere, Shelter protects whoever you want alive, Glory draws rulers in. Snap big to eat more, or small to keep anglers for tomorrow.

quirk.title: Hooked
quirk.text: A faction that takes a Treasure lure's card is hooked until your next Dusk: you can snap at it in any reef.

plates.craft: A lure pays its reef's suit, then goes dark: no offer, and no snap there, until you relight it at Dawn.

plates.name: Octopus
plates.idea: One giant octopus whose eight arms think for themselves. Each arm keeps a standing order and carries it out every turn, in number order. Whatever the arms steal goes into the garden, and when trouble comes, the octopus inks and jets away.

rules.title: Orders
rules.text: At Dawn, put 1 or 2 cards under arms with no order, and you may swap the orders of two arms. The suit is the order. Kelp: reach, move that arm one channel, ignoring rule. Sponge: grab, battle in its reef. Pearl: steal, take an enemy token from its reef, or a random card from a faction with pieces there, into your garden. Moon: pick each time.

rules.title: Recoil
rules.text: Arms act from 1 to 8. If an arm can't carry out its order, discard the orders on it and on every higher arm, and lose 1 VP per order discarded.

rules.title: Reach
rules.text: Arms stay within 2 channels of the Mantle, your body. After the Mantle moves, arms out of reach snap back to it. Lost arms keep their orders, skip their turn, and regrow at the Mantle at Dusk.

plates.pieces: The Mantle and 8 numbered arms, all warriors.
plates.setup: The Mantle and all 8 arms in one reef that isn't a gate.

turn.text: Add orders, and swap two if you like.
Arms act, 1 to 8. Then the Mantle may move to any reef with one of your arms.
Regrow arms, then score the garden.

scores: Each treasure scores 1 VP when stolen, token or card.

At Dusk, 1 VP per kind of treasure in your garden: each token type, and each suit of stolen card. If the Mantle is removed, the garden is lost and the Mantle returns at Dawn beside any arm, or at any gate if no arm is left.
plates.choice: Program the arms well and they run themselves. Spend treasures on gear, or keep them for the garden.

quirk.title: Ink
quirk.text: When battled, you may discard a card: the battle ends before any hits, and your pieces there jet to a neighboring reef.

plates.craft: Garden treasures: a stolen card pays its suit, a stolen token pays any suit. Crafting spends them.

plates.name: Cuttlefish
plates.tagline: Trust your eyes. Everyone else does.
plates.idea: Cuttlefish change color in a heartbeat. They repaint reefs to a new suit for every faction, hypnotize whatever stands in the way, and score by ruling patterns across the map.

rules.title: Paint
rules.text: Discard a card to put a pigment of its suit (Moon: any suit) in a reef with your cuttlefish, or to move one of your pigments there. That reef is that suit for every faction and every rule.

rules.title: Camouflage
rules.text: To battle your cuttlefish in a painted reef, a faction must first discard a card of that reef's suit.

rules.title: Galleries
rules.text: Three face-up Gallery cards each show a pattern, such as three connected reefs of one suit. At Dusk, score every pattern made of reefs you rule, then replace each one you scored.

plates.setup: 3 cuttlefish in each of two reefs.

turn.text: 1 cuttlefish arrives in each reef with your pigment, or 2 at any gate if you have no pigment on the map.
3 actions: move, battle, paint, hypnotize, or hatch (discard a card: 2 cuttlefish in a reef of its suit where you have cuttlefish, or in any reef of its suit if you have none on the map).
Score galleries.

scores: At Dusk, every Gallery pattern you rule scores its 2 or 3 VP.
plates.choice: Paint toward your own patterns, hypnotize rivals out of the reefs you need, or hatch more cuttlefish to hold them.

quirk.title: Hypnotize
quirk.text: Discard a card: move up to 3 warriors of another faction from a reef with your cuttlefish to a neighboring reef. Cuttlefish hunt by rippling stripes until the prey freezes.

shared.title: Twelve reefs
shared.text: Each reef has a suit (Kelp, Sponge or Pearl) and one to three slots for buildings. Channels connect neighboring reefs.

shared.title: Edges of the map
shared.text: The four corner reefs are gates to the open ocean. The top row is the shore. The three reefs touching the Trench are the rim.

shared.title: A turn
shared.text: Dawn, Day, Dusk. At Dusk every faction draws a card and discards down to five. A round is one turn for every faction.

shared.title: Pieces
shared.text: Warriors fight and count for rule. Buildings fill slots and count for rule. Tokens sit in a reef and don't count. Channel markers sit on channels, one per channel, and can't be hit. Removed pieces go back to their owner's supply.

shared.title: Rule and moving
shared.text: You rule a reef when you have the most warriors and buildings there; a tie means nobody does. A move takes any number of your warriors to a neighboring reef, and you must rule where you leave or where you arrive. Placing pieces from your supply isn't moving. A push moves another faction's warriors for it, ignoring rule; it counts as that faction's move.

shared.title: Currents
shared.text: Moving along a current never needs rule. Four currents circle the middle of the map as the Gyre.

shared.title: Attacks and hits
shared.text: An attack is a battle or any ability that deals hits. Each hit removes one of the target's pieces in that reef, warriors first, and its owner picks which. Removing an enemy building or token scores 1 VP. Removing warriors scores nothing unless a plate says so.

shared.title: Battle
shared.text: Pick a reef with your warriors and a faction with pieces there. Roll two dice showing 0 to 3: you deal the higher, the defender deals the lower, each capped by its warriors there. A defender with no warriors takes 1 extra hit. An Ambush card of the reef's suit deals 2 hits before the roll.

shared.title: Cards
shared.text: 54 cards in Kelp, Sponge, Pearl and wild Moon. Once per turn, a faction with a fixed number of Day actions may discard a card for one more.

shared.title: Gear
shared.text: Every faction crafts. Its plate names its crafting pieces, and each piece pays one suit, once per turn. Pay a gear card's cost to craft it: score its VP and keep its lasting bonus.

shared.title: Winning
shared.text: First to 30 VP. Once you have 10 VP you may play a Dominance card instead: you stop scoring, and you win if you rule three reefs of its suit at the start of your turn (Moon: two opposite gates).
